efficiency.source: Editable 0.84 modeling assumption. The owner saturation curve was formula-generated and supplies no measured-efficiency evidence.

power_w.source: Mean wall power while decoding, measured 12 to 13 October 2026 on the machine this model is calibrated for (Vulkan backend, four models, four context lengths, three repeats, uncalibrated plug that reads whole watts), from the energy study at roamingpigs.org/studies/strix-halo-energy/. Other machines keep their assumed values.

power_w.source: 45% of the 700 W board rating. Published decode measurements report 34 to 60% of rated power (see sources). GPU board only: excludes host, networking and cooling.

tariff_note: EIA Electric Power Monthly, release 2026-09-24: US residential 18.31 cents per kWh, commercial 14.53 cents per kWh, July 2026.
api_note: A 30B-A3B-class open-weight model was listed at $0.50 per million output tokens by one provider (DeepInfra, undated page, fetched 2026-10-11). Prices vary widely. Set your own.
